scope: V8.9+ owner-approved FORMAL_GENERAL + FORMAL_THOUSAND ring-fenced strategy accounting; Hybrid excluded because Shadow-only

linkageToB217.gateLimited: qualifiedCount<3; selectedCount=qualifiedCount and unused seats are upstream qualification scarcity.
linkageToB217.exactlyFilled: qualifiedCount=3; no unused seat and no displaced rank4+.
linkageToB217.quotaBinding: qualifiedCount>3; selectedCount remains 3 and rank4+ qualified names are displaced.
linkageToB217.crossPoolStranding: one pool qualifiedCount<3 while the opposite pool qualifiedCount>3; unused seat coexists with opposite-pool qualified displacement.
linkageToB217.rightCensoring: selectedCount=3 alone proves only qualifiedCount>=3, so quota state is UNKNOWN without a complete pre-cut denominator.

decompositionLayers.observableCondition: qualifiedCount<3 when complete same-generation pre-cut population exists
decompositionLayers.capitalMeaning: Selected-count geometry leaves 100% / 65% / 40% nominal reserve in that pool for 0 / 1 / 2 selected names.
decompositionLayers.nonClaim: Does not prove the gates are too strict.

decompositionLayers.capitalMeaning: Pool still has selectedCount=3 and nominal 85% deploy target; quota changes which names are admitted, not the current nominal deploy target.
decompositionLayers.nonClaim: Displaced rank4+ does not imply more capital should be deployed.

decompositionLayers.observableCondition: one Formal pool underfilled while the other cannot transfer names/capital across pool boundary
decompositionLayers.capitalMeaning: Consolidated Formal-strategy deployment can remain far below 85% even when the opposite pool is full.
decompositionLayers.nonClaim: Ring-fencing may protect liquidity/price-level/concentration and is not shown harmful.

decompositionLayers.observableCondition: actual planned allocation sum below the selected-count nominal target because of 35% cap and NT$1000 flooring
decompositionLayers.capitalMeaning: Additional planned cash beyond the nominal structural reserve.

decompositionLayers.observableCondition: plan exists but intraday activation/execution not fully observed
decompositionLayers.capitalMeaning: Downstream cash is not attributable from selected-count geometry.
decompositionLayers.guard: B-218/B-219: exhaustive NO-BUY denominator remains unavailable.

highValueCounterexamples.result: General is nominally 85% deployed inside its own 200k pool, but consolidated two-Formal-pool nominal deployment is only 42.5% of 400k strategy capital.
highValueCounterexamples.implication: A 'full' pool does not imply high consolidated utilization when the opposite ring-fenced pool is empty.

highValueCounterexamples.result: Each pool nominally deploys 35%; consolidated Formal nominal deployment is also 35%, not 70%.
highValueCounterexamples.implication: Pool percentages cannot be arithmetically added without their capital denominators.

highValueCounterexamples.result: Even both quotas filled imply nominal deployment 340k/400k=85%, leaving a 15% design reserve before cap/rounding and before any BUY/fill uncertainty.
highValueCounterexamples.implication: 100% capital utilization is not the current Formal design target.

firstTrancheClarification.guard: These are plan-size arithmetic only (deploy ratio × 60%). They are not observed exposure and must not be called fills.

optimizationFirewall: Higher utilization is not automatically better.
Do not relax gates, quota, ring fence, cap, rounding, BUY confirmation or maxChase from this algebra alone.
Any capital/quota behavior change is Class C and requires owner approval after prospective/OOS/cost/risk evidence.
Cause attribution requires the correct same-generation qualified denominator; selectedCount=3 is right-censored.
